study type: Experimental (in vivo mouse model and in vitro cellular model)
outcome: Pathogenesis of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation of the lungs (CCAML)
cohort: The participants were a mouse model with high KLF5 expression in the lungs and human lung adenocarcinoma (H441) cells transfected with the KLF5 gene.
finding: High KLF5 expression may play a pivotal role in the pathogenesis of CCAML, partly through regulating the activity of MMP-9.
